primary_sources.title: The fundamental gap of simplices
primary_sources.inspection: arXiv:1109.4117v2, Theorem 3 on printed p.3; introduction identifies algorithmic part of original proof; text inspected.
primary_sources.verified_scope: All triangles satisfy diameter-normalized gap at least 64*pi^2/9; theorem accepted as published prior work, original computational proof not independently replayed.
